context.why: US1 and US2 built the record views and fields in fairdm/contrib/autocomplete (views, fields, throttling, urls; tests in tests/test_contrib/test_autocomplete/). Read them and follow their patterns; extend, do not restructure. US3 adds RecordMultipleFilter in fairdm/contrib/autocomplete/filters.py (a django-filter filter drawing the multiple record field at scope 'public' by default, counted control), moves the project list's owner (organization) and contributor (person) filters, the dataset list's project filter, the sample list's dataset filter and the measurement list's dataset and sample filters, and the filters generated for a registered type for a related project, dataset, sample or measurement (fairdm/registry/factories.py _get_smart_filters). The project keyword filters move off django-autocomplete-light to mvp_forms.widgets.TomSelectMultiple(counted=True). IMPORTANT: the person and organization views and fields do not exist yet (US5). For the project list's owner and contributor filters, leave them as they are now and note it; US5 moves them. IMPORTANT: fairdm/api/filters.py builds API filtersets from the same mixins and expects plain ModelChoiceFilter 'sample'/'dataset' with querysets (an earlier attempt that swapped filters on the mixins broke the API with KeyError 'sample'). Keep the API filtersets working: run tests/test_api. Known state of the base: one test, tests/test_core/test_measurement/test_forms.py::TestMeasurementFormPolymorphicHandling::test_form_handles_cross_dataset_sample_reference, fails because of an open question with the maintainer about cross-dataset samples. Do not touch it or the measurement form's sample field.
prior_decisions: D1: a field that places a record inside another needs edit; linking needs view; a public list filter offers public records only, to everyone.
D3: visibility rules are taken as they stand (project by visibility; dataset by get_visible on all_objects; sample/measurement by public+published dataset).
D4: a stored link to a record the editor cannot see is kept and shown as a private record without its name.
D12: limits on the pattern of fairdm/api/throttling.py, refused before any query.

D13: design review. django-tomselect rebuilds the validation view as view_class() (lazy_utils.py:107) and with the current page's q/f/e. So: one view subclass per scope (scope is a class attribute), and FairDM fields validate through the view's offered(user, owner=, type=, depends_on=) and never call django-tomselect's clean(). Use django-tomselect's allowed_filter_fields and allowed_ordering_fields, not a custom allow-list.
Upstream gaps are tracked in this repository's issue #554. Put '#554' in the comments of the two django_tomselect templates.
FR-021 (the 'searching is paused' message) is with the maintainer. Do NOT build it and do NOT write a skipped test for it.
